title: Cloud Impermanence
meta: Output: 4K/HD digital video (MP4/MOV), seamless loop; USB, download, or NFT
statement:
A calm, continuous field of clouds forms, thins out, and gathers again. Light and color keep changing—soft rose, aquamarine, muted gold, deep blue—with no single scene holding for long. The motion is slow and immersive, like breath. There is no finale, only transition: presence felt rather than performed. The work treats impermanence as the subject—what you see, and what you feel, are always becoming something else.

Soundtrack: Composed by Melis Ragusin using layered elements from Artlist — licensed via Artlist.io.
